items.heading: Poutine
details: Key ingredients: fries, cheese curds, gravy
Fry potatoes until golden and crisp.
Scatter fresh cheese curds generously over the hot fries.
Ladle warm brown gravy over the top so the curds start to soften.
Serve immediately while everything is hot and gooey.

items.heading: Tourtiere
details: Key ingredients: pastry dough, ground pork, potato, onion, spices
Simmer ground pork with diced potato, onion and warm spices.
Cool the filling slightly, then spoon it into a pastry-lined pie dish.
Cover with a top crust and seal the edges, cutting vents.
Bake until the crust is golden and flaky.
